body.contents: The Spell Wheel is how you activate any spell in the Wizarding World. There are 7 pages, each with 4 slots (28 slots total). The controls are simple.

Left Click - Activate Slot 1 
 Double Left Click - Activate Slot 2 
 Right Click - Activate Slot 3 
 Double Right Click - Activate Slot 4 
 Scroll Up/Down - Change Pages
To Bind spells to slots, click on the Book Item; his is the Field Guide. From the home page, click on the Spell Wheel Button and start customizing!
This message can be found in the Field Guide Settings page. If you have any questions Join my discord or look on the datapack Modrinth Page
